candidateCoverage.notes: Fresh 2009-10 lineup-based representative shortlist; does NOT claim all squad members or three-season independent grade verification.

meta.europeanQualificationReview: 7 actual Italian 2010-11 UEFA entrants: UCL Inter Roma Milan Sampdoria (play-offs, then UEL), UEL Palermo Napoli Juventus. No Intertoto after 2008.
meta.formationReview: Period Italian diamond representative working hypothesis, not proof of most used formation in all 380 domestic Serie A fixtures.

bestXiReview.notes: XI assembled for historical role fitness, personal rather than club trophy contribution; independent full 3-season opponent peers pending.

historicalExceptions: 2009-10 domestic Inter Milito and Thiago Motta transferred from Genoa (2008-09) to Internazionale in summer 2009. Samuel Eto'o moved from Barcelona, Sneijder from Real Madrid, Lúcio from Bayern Munich.
Sampdoria played 2010-11 UCL qualifying play-off and continued in UEL group stage.
Coppa Italia finalists Inter and Roma qualified via league, 7th Juventus entered 2010-11 UEL.
Player rows with unknown domestic games/starts/minutes remain null, not fabricated; past 2008-09 DRAFT is not independently verified proof.

qualifiers.route: 4th, played UCL play-off then transferred to Europa League
7th; Coppa Italia finalists Inter and Roma already qualified via league, UEL allocation passed to 7th
